note: A roomId filter. The request deliberately carries nothing: a filter would turn this into "is my principal in THAT room", which is a different question with a different answer and no authorization story of its own. `additionalProperties: false` is what keeps the two apart.
A subject. A recipient answers for its own principal and for nobody else; a member naming whose rooms to list is the shape of a task this one is not.
Paging members. Rooms are bounded by how many a person is in, so there is no cursor to issue and none to accept — a caller that sent one would be relying on behaviour no recipient implements.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
